scripts.setup:mcp: npm run build -w @diffdeck/mcp && npm run build -w @diffdeck/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js setup-mcp
scripts.setup:mcp:print: npm run build -w @diffdeck/mcp && npm run build -w @diffdeck/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js setup-mcp --print
scripts.setup:mcp:codex: npm run build -w @diffdeck/mcp && npm run build -w @diffdeck/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js setup-mcp --target codex
scripts.build: npm run build -w @diffdeck/core && npm run build -w @diffdeck/server && npm run build -w @diffdeck/mcp && npm run build -w @diffdeck/cli && npm run build -w @diffdeck/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @diffdeck/core && npm run build -w @diffdeck/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
